title: TMP Camera Surveillance Next 2.20.93
summary: Cloud-Aufnahme-Archiv nutzt zwischengespeicherte HLS-Videosegmente statt MP4-Download und pro-Segment-Konvertierung.
changes: Generate 30-second cached HLS VOD windows from finalized archive blocks on demand
Serve 2-second pre-existing HLS segments over the same authenticated cloud relay approach as live feeds
Use H264 copy-first and AAC normalization; bound and cache H264 transcoding when needed
Limit concurrent archive preparation to two, queue eight, and enforce 384MiB disk cache with 90-minute retention
Private PHP 3.1.0: read-only archive list and iPhone HLS VOD player, no emojis and no MP4 downloads
name: TMP Camera Surveillance Next v2.20.93
description: Rebuild cloud recording archive playback on secure cached HLS segments like the working live HLS route
releaseNotes: Deploy private Plesk PHP 3.1.0 first, then update camera backend to 2.20.93. Original recordings stay unchanged. Production Plesk/iPhone end-to-end tests are still required.
